exp=[]
for l in open('/home/user/audit_logs/raw/auth.log',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace'):

  if m: exp.append(['2023-10-01T'+m.group(1),m.group(2),m.group(3),m.group(4).strip()])
got=[[c.strip() for c in r] for r in list(csv.reader(open('/home/user/audit_logs/processed/sudo_audit_2023-10-01.csv',encoding='utf-8')))[1:]]
raise SystemExit(0 if got==exp else 1)"
